hooks.name: livearch-sync-on-iac-change
hooks.description: When the agent saves an IaC file, run an incremental LiveArch sync of docs/architecture/.

action.prompt: An Infrastructure as Code file was just saved. Use the architecture-diagrams skill to run an INCREMENTAL sync of docs/architecture/: rebuild model.json for the changed files, compute the changeset, render with scripts/render.py and validate with scripts/validate_architecture.py. Do not modify any IaC file and do not edit the diagram files directly. If the IaC does not parse, leave docs/architecture/ untouched and report PARSE_ERROR. End with the changeset in at most 5 lines.

hooks.name: livearch-block-manual-diagram-writes
hooks.description: Generated diagrams must come from render.py, never from direct agent file writes.

action.command: python3 -c "import json,re,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=json.dumps(d.get('tool_input',{})); m=re.search(r'docs/architecture/architecture\.(drawio|mmd|archimate\.xml)', p); sys.stderr.write('LiveArch: diagrams are generated. Update docs/architecture/model.json and run scripts/render.py from the architecture-diagrams skill.\n') if m else None; sys.exit(2 if m else 0)"
